mapper.select: SELECT user_id, enabled, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM user_account ORDER BY user_id
SELECT user_id, role_code FROM user_role_assignment ORDER BY user_id, role_code

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account.user_id) FROM user_account account INNER JOIN user_role_assignment role ON role.user_id = account.user_id WHERE account.enabled = TRUE AND role.role_code = 'ROLE_ADMIN' AND account.user_id <> #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (user_account_uuid, user_id, password, enabled, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{password}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
INSERT INTO user_role_assignment (user_role_assignment_id, user_id, role_code, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{roleCode}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT role_code FROM user_role_assignment WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY role_code
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM user_role_assignment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND role_code = 'ROLE_ADMIN'
SELECT code_field, code_before, code_after FROM code_definition WHERE code_group = 'api-screen-authorization' AND code_field IN (#{httpMethod}, '*') AND active_flag = 'Y' AND review_status = 'S'

SELECT review.unique_key, review.review_status FROM change_review review INNER JOIN ( SELECT unique_key, MAX(id) AS latest_id FROM change_review WHERE function_code = #{functionCode} GROUP BY unique_key ) latest ON latest.latest_id = review.id
SELECT user_id, function_code, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM user_screen_authorization ORDER BY user_id, function_code
SELECT user_id, function_code, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM user_screen_authorization WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY function_code
SELECT function_code FROM user_screen_authorization WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY function_code
SELECT code_before FROM code_definition WHERE code_group = 'main-screen' AND code_field = 'function_code' AND active_flag = 'Y' AND review_status = 'S' ORDER BY code_before
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_screen_authorization (user_screen_authorization_id, user_id, function_code, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{functionCode}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
